description: This file manages Telegram execution approval configurations, approvers, target recipient checks, and approval button handling within a plugin SDK context.

methods.name: normalizeApproverId
methods.description: Normalizes an approver ID to a trimmed string.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramDirectApproverId
methods.description: Normalizes a Telegram approver ID, returning undefined if invalid or a group chat ID.

methods.name: resolveTelegramExecApprovalConfig
methods.description: Resolves the Telegram execution approval configuration for a given account.

methods.name: getTelegramExecApprovalApprovers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of approvers for Telegram execution approval.

methods.name: isTelegramExecApprovalTargetRecipient
methods.description: Checks if a recipient is a target for Telegram execution approval.

methods.name: countTelegramExecApprovalEligibleAccounts
methods.description: Counts the number of eligible Telegram accounts for approval based on configuration and filters.

methods.name: matchesTelegramRequestAccount
methods.description: Determines if a request matches a specific Telegram account based on turn source and account ID.

methods.name: resolveExecApprovalButtonsExplicitlyDisabled
methods.description: Checks if Telegram inline approval buttons are explicitly disabled in capabilities.

methods.name: shouldEnableTelegramExecApprovalButtons
methods.description: Determines if approval buttons should be enabled for a given target.

methods.name: shouldSuppressLocalTelegramExecApprovalPrompt
methods.description: Checks if local approval prompt should be suppressed.

methods.name: isTelegramExecApprovalHandlerConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the Telegram approval handler is properly configured.
